lines: This tiny engine beats an 8B-parameter LLM. And it's 11× faster.
It's called Statim. It reads text or JSON, and answers typed questions.
Send it a support ticket. In one forward pass, you get the department, the urgency, and whether they want a refund.
Under the hood, your text and every question become one token sequence. One encoder pass, and all the answers come out at once.
No Python. No PyTorch. Just one 5 MB binary.
On a single RTX 3070, it makes 68 decisions per second. Qwen3-8B manages about 6.
Cold start to first answer? Under half a second, on a plain CPU.
Already using Laya or Jev? Statim speaks the same protocol. Just change the base URL.
Want to try it first? There's a live demo in your browser. No install, no key.
Download. Start. Ask. Three steps, and you're running.
